summary:
This is printed page 619 of the index (PDF 643). The left column finishes the **S** entries (stemming to synchronous training) and starts **T** (tanh activation, target, TensorBoard, TensorFlow …); the right column continues T through *Top-K sampling*.

**How to use it:** numbers are *printed* pages; add 24 for the PDF page.

**Main clusters on this page**

- **Optimization and tensors:** *stochastic gradient descent* 43–46 (PDF 67–70), *tensor operations, derivatives of* 42–43 (PDF 66–67), *tensors, defined* 63 (PDF 87), *strided convolutions* 239 (PDF 263).
- **Text processing (chapter 14):** *text classification* 381 (PDF 405) with sub-entries such as preparing text data 384–394 (PDF 408–418), sets vs. sequences 395–398 (PDF 419–422), sequence models 405 (PDF 429), word embeddings 409, 410 (PDF 433, 434); *tokenization* 387 (PDF 411), *subword tokenization* 390–394 (PDF 414–418), *stemming* 386–387 (PDF 410–411), *TextVectorization layer* 399, … (PDF 423, …).
- **Text generation (chapter 16):** *text generation* 466 (PDF 490), training mini-GPT 470–484 (PDF 494–508), using pretrained LLMs 484–494 (PDF 508–518), LLMs 495–504 (PDF 519–528), *Top-K sampling* 482 (PDF 506).
- **Images from text (chapter 17):** *text-to-image models* 509, 531–537 (PDF 533, 555–561).
- **TensorFlow:** *TensorFlow* 60 (PDF 84), *TensorBoard* 212 (PDF 236), *tf.data API* 248 (PDF 272), *tf.GradientTape()* 302 (PDF 326), *TensorFlow Serving* 185 (PDF 209).
- **Timeseries (chapter 13):** *timeseries forecasting* 351 (PDF 375), temperature forecasting example 352–364 (PDF 376–388), *timeseries_dataset_from_array()* 356, 357 (PDF 380, 381).
- **Other:** *subclassing Model class* 202 (PDF 226), *symbolic AI* 3 (PDF 27), *symbols* 584–594 (PDF 608–618), *test-time training* 582 (PDF 606).

concepts.name: Stochastic gradient descent
concepts.intuition: Update the weights a little in the direction that lowers the loss on a random batch of data.
concepts.technical: Preceded by 'tensor operations, derivatives of' 42–43 (PDF 66–67), the gradient background.
concepts.significance: The core training algorithm behind everything else in the book.
concepts.example: Open PDF 67 for the mini-batch SGD description.
concepts.misconception: Printed 43 is not PDF 43; the PDF page is 67.

concepts.name: Tokenization
concepts.definition: Index entry: printed 387 → PDF 411; subword tokenization 390–394 → PDF 414–418.
concepts.intuition: Splitting text into units (words, subwords, characters) that can be mapped to integer ids.
concepts.technical: Related entries: stemming 386–387 (PDF 410–411), tokens 384 (PDF 408), TextVectorization layer 399 (PDF 423).
concepts.significance: The first step of every text model in chapters 14–16.
concepts.example: Word tokenization is indexed separately at 387–390 (PDF 411–414) on the next index page.
concepts.misconception: Tokenization and vectorization are separate steps; the index lists them separately.

concepts.name: Text generation
concepts.definition: Index entry: printed 466 → PDF 490, with sub-entries through 504 (PDF 528).
concepts.intuition: Generating text token by token from a trained language model.
concepts.technical: Sub-entries: history of sequence generation 468–470 (PDF 492–494), training mini-GPT 470–484 (PDF 494–508), using pretrained LLMs 484–494 (PDF 508–518), LLMs 495–504 (PDF 519–528).
concepts.significance: Chapter 16 is the book's LLM chapter.
concepts.example: Top-K sampling is at printed 482, PDF 506.
